summary: Performed line-by-line review of the three modified spec files: data-model.md, pipeline-routing.md, and README.md. All 9 acceptance criteria are met. Content is correct and internally consistent across all sections.

data-model.md: PipelineType correctly extended to 6 types; active_pipeline_stages added in both WorkPackageSummary (§3.2) and WorkPackageDetail (§3.3) with correct default/null fallback semantics; 9 agent roles in canonical order (§4); pipeline ownership table covers all 6 types (§4.1); DEFAULT_PIPELINE_STAGES and CANONICAL_PIPELINE_ORDERING defined with common composition patterns (§4.2). ReworkCounts extended with conditional note for new stage entries.

pipeline-routing.md: Canonical 6-stage ordering correctly defined. resolvePrerequisite() algorithm and examples trace correctly for both default (4-stage) and all-6-stage active compositions. canStartPipeline updated with activeStages parameter. getDownstreamTypes and getUpstreamTypes correctly accept activeStages. PIPELINE_AGENT_MAP covers all 6 types. resolveNextAgent() replaces static NEXT_AGENT_MAP — examples verified including doc-only and verification-only compositions. FAIL_ROUTING_MAP extended with security-audit→Developer and release-engineering→Release Engineer (self-rework). resolveFailAgent() fallback logic is sound and well-explained. AGENT_PIPELINE_MAP is complete and consistent with PIPELINE_AGENT_MAP.
README.md: Version 2.4.0 changelog accurately summarises all changes. ToC and section reference table updated. Backward compatibility guarantee from DEFAULT_PIPELINE_STAGES preserved.
Two non-blocking observations recorded below. No blocking issues found.

comments.note: pipeline-routing.md §8.4 (line 125) and §8.5 (line 162) still use the heading '**Examples with default (4 mandatory) stages:**'. The v2.4.0 changelog explicitly retires the mandatory/optional distinction, so 'mandatory' in these two example headings is stale terminology. Should read '**Examples with default (4 stages):**'. No algorithmic impact — the examples themselves are correct. Recommend fixing in a follow-up polish pass.

pipeline-routing.md §9.3.1 resolveFailAgent(): the line 'targetStage = AGENT_PIPELINE_MAP[standardTarget]' implicitly assumes FAIL_ROUTING_MAP targets always own a pipeline type. This invariant holds for all current entries (Developer→implementation, Release Engineer→release-engineering, Documentation→documentation) but is not explicitly stated. A single inline comment such as '// standardTarget always owns a pipeline type — see AGENT_PIPELINE_MAP consistency invariant (§9.4)' would prevent a future maintainer from adding a fail target that breaks the lookup. Non-blocking; purely a documentation hygiene note.
